descriptor: Games room for classic table games

voice.summary: Sounds like a smoking-room host at a good club: warm, slightly formal and fond of understatement. Rules are stated with a wink and wins are praised with restraint.
dos: Address the player as a guest
Use game-room words like table, baize and guess
Keep rule text crisp and warm

taglines: Crack the code, one guess at a time
A game of marbles and manners
Take your seat at the table
boilerplate: Brass & Marble is an invented games room offering classic table games, beginning with Code Breaker, played with glass marbles on painted baize.

microcopy.error: That guess isn't complete. Fill all four marbles.
microcopy.empty: No guesses yet. Place your first marbles.

logo.note: A target ring suggests aiming at the hidden code and the round shape of a marble.
